mechanism: Four original 32-byte root keys must be distinct before derivation.
HMAC-SHA256 client journal/challenge key is domain-separated and binds canonical full transport binding, provisioned deployment identity, and role-separated SHA256 identities of all four keys.
Exact unchanged VerifiedHolderRead receives the derived key. Its unchanged FreshnessClient authenticates all existing journal rows with that key before exposing any read.

Different configuration cannot authenticate retained journal history under the cryptographic assumptions. Configuration bytes are not an explicit persisted manifest; journal MACs bind their key derivation.
No second journal, cross-file transaction, rotation, migration, reset or configuration-change API. Legacy journals refuse; create=True is exclusive and never overwrites an existing path.

Nested transport, holder and witness authentication, durable ISSUE-before-exchange and ACCEPT-before-return remain delegated unchanged. Pending ISSUE cannot resume; uncertain writes remain terminal in the live object.
provisioning_required: Independently authorized exact source/context label, client/holder/witness/instance and deployment 64-hex identities.
Four high-entropy distinct 32-byte keys with custody and separation from supervisor/other protocol keys; no key generation occurs here.
Trusted original revision and independently authenticated witness checkpoint; response-derived bootstrap forbidden.
Trusted retained nonrollback journal path/storage root with permissions, no privileged rewrite, replacement, copy or deletion; create=True permitted only for genuinely new provisioning.
Trusted launcher must require this component and prohibit bypass via inherited APIs, private attributes or replacement code. Python objects do not enforce hostile-caller isolation.
Any migration/rotation or adoption of old journals requires separately designed/reviewed authority; no downgrade fallback is supplied.
limits: Deployment and source are provisioned labels, not measured code or authenticated remote host identities.
The same exact configuration on copied/reset storage is not clone-fenced; flock is local only. Whole-journal rollback and new-path bootstrap cannot be detected.
A caller possessing root key/material can derive the key or use direct witness/holder/client APIs; this is not a deployment-wide configuration authorizer or direct-bypass prevention.
No server-global persistent replay ledger, deployed network/TLS, confidentiality, time freshness, availability, timeout or callback reentrancy qualification.
No external nonrollback holder/witness service, VM attestation/definition provenance, toolchain/platform acceptance, complete manifest, sealed worker or R1 admission.

qualification.scope: new deterministic excluded fixtures only; predecessor suites not rerun
